resources.string: You have 8 chances to guess the football player from the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga or Ligue 1. After each guess, feedback will be revealed, showing how close your guess is to the mystery footballer in a number of categories.

Example: Luka Modrić … Means that the mystery player is not Croatian, plays in La Liga and does not play for Real Madrid. However, the player is a midfielder and they are under the age of 38 whilst not having a shirt number #10.
